about: PLACEHOLDER voices for timing only (Kokoro-82M TTS). The creator writes all dialogue and picks the final voices. Source: docs/HELL-SCRIPT.md; rebuild with make_hell_voices.py.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Your sister is dead.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You didn't grieve. You went, furious, to the one who took her.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: Mortals usually wait their turn. You're early. I could fix that.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: ...Wait. I've had the funniest idea.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: Lucifer took a bride down there alive. Vesper. Kill her. Teach him whose souls these are. And do me a few favours on the way.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: Shadow to hide in. Time to bend. A door into Hell, which I don't have. Your sister is down there too. Oh, and don't take too long.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: Two ways through every room. The long safe one, and the one I'd take.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: See the dark there? Step into it. Shadows are doors, if you're mine.
lines.trigger: the first dark landing in Step range

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: Aim while you're flying. The faster you move, the longer the world waits.
lines.trigger: the first time you are fast and airborne with an enemy in view

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: That looked fatal. Take four seconds back. I'm only lending them.
lines.trigger: the first hit that leaves you under 30 health, or the first lethal bolt in flight

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: That's lava. It's hot. I really shouldn't have to tell you this.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: The floor's leaving. I'd leave with it. Ahead of it, ideally.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: Both hands. No stepping through shadows until you put it down.
lines.trigger: first pick-up of the Soul Lantern (or the hourglass)

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: A gift. Pick one. Don't make me regret my generosity.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: Oh, while you're down there. A small favour. You'll see my mark.
lines.trigger: the first job pocket comes into view

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: No, no. You die when I say. Up.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: That one comes off her clock, you know.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: Embarrassing. For both of us. Again.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: I'm counting. She's counting too.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: She let you live once. Don't make it a habit.
lines.trigger: a death in the boss fight

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: There's a viscount on a balcony down there who keeps sending me fruit baskets. Make it stop. Permanently.
lines.trigger: The Viscount of Cinders (Six Sigils, floor 1): briefing

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: No more pears. Bless you.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: He got away. Expect a basket. Addressed to YOU.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: Albrecht Huss is three hundred years overdue. He's hiding in a cage. Cute. Step in and collect him.
lines.trigger: The Overdue Soul (Break the Chains, floor 1): briefing

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: Filed. Three centuries late, but filed.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: You walked past him. He waved. I saw.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: One of my reapers dropped my good hourglass down there. Fetch it. Don't shake it.
lines.trigger: The Lost Hourglass (Ooze Wells, floor 1): briefing

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: Oh, it's even still running. Good boy.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: You left it. On the floor. In HELL.

lines.speaker: vesper
lines.text: Who let a living thing down here? ...Oh. You smell of her. The bone collector.
lines.trigger: the Lantern picked up (or the fallback)

lines.speaker: vesper
lines.text: Turn around. Whatever she promised you, she's lying, or she's bored.

lines.speaker: vesper
lines.text: I'll be at the bottom. Everything reaches the bottom eventually.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: Don't chat with the target. It's unprofessional.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: Some clerk is stamping my dead 'CANCELLED'. Burn his book. Not him. Well. Him too, if he fusses.
lines.trigger: The Ledger of Ash (Soul Lantern, floor 2): briefing

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: Ashes. Lovely. Paperwork is the real Hell.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: Filed. In triplicate. I hate him so much.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: A scythe demon is poaching my souls and selling them by the jar. Kill him from the dark. He spooks.
lines.trigger: The Poacher (Hold the Brand, floor 2): briefing

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: Quietly done. I didn't even hear it, and I hear everything.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: He spooked. Through a rift, with my jars.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: Someone chained up my dog. My SMALL dog. Break the chains. The smith keeps re-forging them, so... deal with that.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: Who's a good boy. Not you. HIM.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: You left my dog in chains. Noted.

lines.speaker: vesper
lines.text: You're still coming. Why? ...Someone, then. Someone you lost.

lines.speaker: vesper
lines.text: I had a daughter. A fever, a week to live. I gave him forever for her week.

lines.speaker: vesper
lines.text: She grew old. She was happy, I'm told. He kept me like a trophy. For a century, he even looked.

lines.speaker: vesper
lines.text: Then he got bored. Do you know what forever is, with no one watching? A very long afternoon.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: A demon has been skimming seconds off my hourglass. He undoes any wound that doesn't finish him. So finish him.
lines.trigger: The Seconds Thief (Six Sigils, floor 3): briefing

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: My seconds. Every last one.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: He's still out there, being ten seconds younger than me.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: A soul's been soaking in a lava spring for six hundred years and calls it a spa. Wade in. Reap him.
lines.trigger: The Lava Bather (Ooze Wells, floor 3): briefing

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: Out of the bath. Finally. He was SO pruney.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: He's still in the tub. Smug.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: A demon is renting out my old cottage down there. Stand at his door while my notice burns in. He'll send friends.
lines.trigger: The Notice on the Door (Soul Lantern, floor 3): briefing

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: Evicted. I may visit. I won't.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: The notice fell off. He's subletting now.

lines.speaker: vesper
lines.text: I know that walk. I walked it, with that same face.

lines.speaker: vesper
lines.text: You'll get her back. And then what will you be for?

lines.speaker: vesper
lines.text: Come down. Let's see which of us is still looking for something.

lines.speaker: vesper
lines.text: So she sent you. I made a deal once too. Let me see what yours bought you.

lines.speaker: vesper
lines.text: Time? I have had nothing BUT time. Watch.

lines.speaker: vesper
lines.text: Again. I have all of it to spare.

lines.speaker: vesper
lines.text: ...You broke it. No one has done that in a long time.

lines.speaker: vesper
lines.text: He grew bored of the light. So did I. Come and find me.

lines.speaker: vesper
lines.text: Get up.

lines.speaker: vesper
lines.text: Not like this. Get up.

lines.speaker: vesper
lines.text: Again, then.
lines.trigger: the fight restarts after your death

lines.speaker: vesper
lines.text: ...There. Something new, at last.

lines.speaker: vesper
lines.text: Go on. She's waiting for my soul. I'd be waiting too.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: Well? Chop chop. I have a lunch.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: It's one shot. You've done a thousand today.

lines.speaker: vesper
lines.text: ...Something to do. It's been so long since anyone asked.

lines.speaker: vesper
lines.text: All right. Run, then. I know the way up.

lines.speaker: vesper
lines.text: Thank you. Tell her she took her time.

lines.speaker: vesper
lines.text: Left! The bridge still remembers me.

lines.speaker: vesper
lines.text: Don't look back. It's the oldest rule down here.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: Lovely. Now run. The whole place is sulking.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: Lucifer is sulking. Delightful. A deal's a deal: one sister, slightly singed.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: Do come by again. Not soon.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: You spared her. You disobeyed me. ...And you did every one of my chores. Ha!

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: Fine. Keep her. Something new for her to live for. You'll owe me one.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: You spared her, and you did nothing I asked. Someone pays for that, darling. Time pays.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: Your sister keeps her years. I'll take mine out of yours.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: Lucifer sent me a fruit basket. ...I'm going to need someone again.
lines.trigger: after the credits, over black, before the title

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: When your sister died, you didn't grieve.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You went looking for the one who took her.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: ...Oh. I've had the funniest idea.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A deal. Shadow to hide in. Time to bend. A door into Hell.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Your sister is down there. So is the woman you were sent to kill.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Every floor burns hotter. Every second is borrowed.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She made the same deal, centuries ago.

lines.speaker: vesper
lines.text: You'll get her back. And then what will you be for?
lines.trigger: act 3, her face in the dark

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Kill the Evening Star. Or offer her your hand.
